panels.description: Total incoming HTTP requests processed per second across all active controller instances (excludes internal Actuator polling loops).

targets.expr: sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])) / ${__range_s}

panels.title: Global Request Rate

panels.description: Core Service Level Objective (Target: >=99.5%). Calculates the percentage of incoming traffic handled without triggering unmanaged HTTP 5xx Server Errors.

targets.expr:
((sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", outcome!="SERVER_ERROR", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])) > 0) * 100)
or vector(100)

panels.title: Global Availability (SLO)

panels.description: The overall infrastructure breakage index. Tracks the fraction of total traffic resulting in an HTTP 5xx outcome.

targets.expr: sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", outcome="SERVER_ERROR", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])) * 100

panels.title: Global Error Rate

panels.description: The macro average processing duration for all incoming server transactions across business domains.

targets.expr: sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Global Average Latency

panels.description: The absolute volumes of total processed requests categorized by HTTP response status families (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx) over the active time range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", status=~"2..", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Status 2xx

panels.description: The absolute volumes of total processed requests categorized by HTTP response status families (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx) over the active time range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", status=~"3..", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Status 3xx

panels.description: The absolute volumes of total processed requests categorized by HTTP response status families (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx) over the active time range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", status=~"4..", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Status 4xx

panels.description: The absolute volumes of total processed requests categorized by HTTP response status families (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx) over the active time range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", status=~"5..", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Status 5xx

panels.description: Real-time transactional load curves plotted directly against a 24-hour historical offset line to instantly capture abnormal load surges or sudden drops.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m]))
sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m] offset 24h))

panels.title: Traffic Rates vs 24h Ago

panels.description: Tail-latency matrix displaying p95 and p99 metrics alongside yesterday's running p95 trendline to flag execution regressions under peak loads.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m] offset 24h)))

panels.title: Server Latency Percentiles vs Baseline

targets.expr:
sum by (uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m]))

panels.title: Avg Latency by URI

panels.description: Time-decaying peak response duration tracking the single worst-case processing duration recorded for each endpoint template during the window.

targets.expr: max by (uri) (http_server_requests_seconds_max{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"})

panels.title: Max Latency (Time-decaying) by URI

targets.expr: sum by (app_name) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m]))

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[2m]))

panels.title: Responses by Status and Code

panels.description: Automated degradation tracking. Captures and lists only those endpoint templates whose current average processing time has slowed down by >20% versus their historical 24h baseline.

targets.expr: ((sum by (app_name, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) / sum by (app_name, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m]))) / (sum by (app_name, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m] offset 24h)) / sum by (app_name, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{space_name="$Namespace", app_name=~"$Application", uri=~"$URI", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m] offset 24h)))) > 1.2
